prompts.rung-6-off-world:
Look first: mark_mountain_base_done is true.
Do: ladder_set mark space_program_open true, then speak one clean line to chat.
Done: mark space_program_open.
Owner: "dominate the universe with a space ewarfare and planet domination".
prompts.space-microelectronics:
Look first: research_current, research_microelectronicsbasics.
Do: queue MicroelectronicsBasics (Research tab, screenshot, click it); pawn_priorities best brain Research=1.
Refused / no bench (research_benches=0): hand back to production.
Done: research_microelectronicsbasics true -> ladder_set mark microelectronics_done true.
Owner: "you have to research microelelectronics to get trade beacons".
prompts.space-trade-beacon:
Look first: game_list_zones -- every storage room.
Do: game_select_architect_designator OrbitalTradeBeacon, apply one INSIDE each storage room (range = its own room).
Refused: check has_power, steel, components.
Never: corridor stockpiles; plant matter goes to the freezer.
Done: every storage room has a powered beacon -> mark trade_beacons_cover true.
Owner: "all storage zones and shelfes and items are withing a orbital trade beacon".
prompts.space-trade-comms:
Look first: silver >= 500, comms_console, has_power.
Do: select best Social pawn, game_right_click_cell the console, game_get_context_menu_options, pick from the drop down: Orbital Traders Hub or a ship that LANDS.
Then right-click the console again -> 'Call <ship>'.
Trade: buy ship needs (plasteel, uranium, adv comps, gold, persona core); sell crops and goods.
Refused: ladder_set mark trade_call_failed true (3 strikes -> caravan fallback).
Done: mark traded_recently true.
Owner: "not orbital trader that one sucks" / "u have to select the the drop down".
prompts.space-trade-comms-fallback:
Comms calls failed 3 times. Stop calling.
A visitor is on the map (humanlikes_not_ours).
Do: order_pawn best Social pawn to the trader, context menu 'Trade with'.
Done: mark traded_recently true.
Owner: "trade with trades via pawns dirrectly when they show up".
prompts.space-ally-gifts:
Look first: transport_pods, pod_launchers, silver.
Do: load a pod with silver, launch it at a friendly settlement as a gift (gizmos Load, then Launch).
Refused (no fuel): skip, try next cycle.
Done: mark gift_sent true.
Owner: "making all factions you can your allies by send gifts with drop pods".
prompts.space-ship-research:
Look first: research_ship* keys.
Do: queue ShipBasics, ShipCryptosleep, ShipReactor, ShipEngine, ShipComputerCore, ShipSensorCluster in order.
Done: all six true -> ladder_set mark research_ship_basics true.
Owner: "dominate the universe with a space ewarfare and planet domination".
prompts.space-persona-core:
Look first: count_aipersonacore.
Do: exotic trader via comms, or quests/shrines that hold a core (game_list_letters).
Done: count >= 1 -> mark persona_core_held true.
Never build ship parts while hunting it.
prompts.space-ship-materials:
Look first: count_steel, count_plasteel, count_uranium, count_componentspacer, count_gold vs the SHIP_* variables.
Do: Mining=1 on two pawns, add_bill for advanced components, buy the rest.
Never place a single ship part yet -- each part raises raid size.
Done: the rung goes dark when every count reaches target.
prompts.space-prelaunch-defence:
Look first: turrets, days_of_food, medicine, able_shooters_armed vs colonists.
Short: let the defence/food rungs work; no ship work.
Done: turrets >= SHIP_TURRETS, food >= 30 days, medicine >= 20, all armed -> mark ship_defence_ready true.
Owner: "you want armies defences turrets all of it".
prompts.ship-launch:
Look first: game_list_architect_designators Ship (never guess names).
Do: beams, computer core, sensor cluster, 3 engines, a casket per colonist, reactor last -- inside/next to the mountain base.
Refused placement: screenshot, move one cell, retry.
Done: ship_parts >= SHIP_PARTS_TARGET -> mark ship_built true.
Owner: "dominate the universe with a space ewarfare and planet domination".
prompts.space-reactor-start:
Look first: ship_built and ship_defence_ready marks.
Do: select the reactor, game_list_selected_gizmos, game_execute_gizmo Start.
Done: mark reactor_started true. Tell chat: fifteen days of raids, stay for the show.
prompts.space-reactor-hold:
Reactor countdown live (15 days).
Defence first; repair reactor and caskets when buildings_damaged.
No new ship parts. Nothing to mark: the timer ends this rung.
prompts.space-launch-load:
Look first: hostiles_on_map false, caskets vs colonists.
Do: each pawn enters a casket (right-click casket, 'Enter cryptosleep casket'), then the Launch gizmo.
Refused (casket short): build one more first.
Done: mark ship_launched true.
Rule: one casket per colonist, nobody left behind.
prompts.grav-core:
Look first: game_list_letters for quests rewarding a grav engine / gravcore.
Do: open and accept.
Done: on receipt ladder_set mark gravcore_found true.
prompts.grav-build:
Look first: game_list_architect_designators Odyssey category.
Do: substructure, engine, thrusters, fuel storage, pilot console; move barracks/freezer/workshop/turrets on.
Done: grav_parts >= GRAV_PARTS_TARGET.
prompts.grav-ready:
Do: fill fuel, check the console gizmos for launch prerequisites.
Done: ladder_set mark gravship_ready true.
prompts.megaship-drop:
Look first: mark war_target_set.
Do: fly near the target tile, pod assault from the ship's launchers, cavalry by caravan.
Owner: "capture prisoners and rule the world. have you even looked at the world yet?"
prompts.space-ask-chat:
Ask chat (clean) which space move is next with twitch_chat.
No answer within a game hour: keep climbing.
Owner: "if they done answer just keep toward your goals of empire world domination and space warfare".
